# A Canadian book whose US dollar bank owes 500.00 USD and whose US dollar
# card holds 500.00 USD in credit, each at 1.30.
#
# Assets:USD Bank pays 500.00 USD of travel at 1.30 while it holds nothing, so
# it goes from 0 to -500.00, acting as a liability: the payment's split opens a
# liability cost basis of 500.00 USD owed at 1.30, 650.00 CAD.
#
# Liabilities:USD Card is paid 500.00 USD from the Canadian bank at 1.30 while
# it owes nothing, so it goes from 0 to 500.00 in credit, acting as an asset:
# the payment's split opens an asset cost basis of 500.00 USD held at 1.30,
# 650.00 CAD.
#
# a_usd_bank_owing_500_at_1_30_and_a_usd_card_in_credit_500_at_1_30_each_crossing_zero_at_1_20_*.txt
# then take each across zero at 1.20.
#
# Verified by
# tests/scenario/test_a_split_crossing_zero_consumes_one_cost_basis_and_opens_another.py.
2034-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2034-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2034-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2034-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2034-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2034-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: "Liability"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2034-01-01 open Liabilities:USD Card
	type: "Credit Card"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2034-01-01 open Income
	type: "Income"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2034-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: "Income"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2034-01-01 open Expenses
	type: "Expense"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2034-01-01 open Expenses:Travel
	type: "Expense"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2034-01-05 * "Travel paid from the empty USD bank"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Expenses:Travel 650.00 CAD
	Assets:USD Bank -500.00 USD
		guid: "0f0f0000000000000000000000000001"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-650.00"

2034-01-05 * "500.00 USD paid onto the empty card"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank -650.00 CAD
	Liabilities:USD Card 500.00 USD
		guid: "0f0f0000000000000000000000000003"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "650.00"
